Norway / PLANNING GUIDE

Norway Travel Planning Guide

Choose a starting city, a season and a manageable route for your Norway break.

By Travelber Editorial · Updated 19 October 2026

IN THIS GUIDE

← Norway overview

The short version

Norway combines fjord-facing cities, wooden historic quarters and Arctic cultural centres.

First break2–3 nightsSuggested approachOne baseStart comparingOslo

Choose a starting city

  • Oslo: Norway's capital combines contemporary waterfront architecture with museums and outdoor sculpture.
  • Bergen: Bergen's historic trading waterfront sits between mountain slopes and Norway's western fjords.
  • Tromsø: Tromsø pairs Arctic exploration history with a lively city centre surrounded by mountains and fjords.
  • Trondheim: Trondheim brings together medieval pilgrimage heritage and colourful wooden neighbourhoods along the Nidelva.
  • Stavanger: Stavanger combines preserved wooden streets with museums exploring Norway's offshore oil industry.

Compare all ten cities

Match the plan to your stay

For two nights, keep one city as your base. With three or four nights, add a second neighbourhood or a carefully checked day trip. For a longer stay, compare actual journey times before adding another base; the city collection is not a suggested rail circuit.

Choose a season

Daylight varies sharply by latitude: Tromsø experiences midnight sun in summer and polar night in winter. Plan outdoor time around your destination and actual travel dates.

Keep the route practical

Rail does not reach Tromsø; plan northern journeys with connecting buses, boats or flights, using Entur to check public transport connections.

Read the transport guide

Before you book

  • Confirm your arrival station or airport and the last connection to your stay.
  • Choose one priority experience per day.
  • Check entry times and cancellation terms with the venue.
  • Keep an indoor alternative and compare total accommodation costs.

Official planning sources

  • Norway tourism
  • Norway journey planning

Editorial planning suggestions, not a personal trip report. Check opening dates, ticket conditions and live journeys before booking.
